name: C. A. Nothnagle Log House

location.text: Gibbstown, Greenwich Township, Gloucester County, New Jersey

dates.built: some parts 1638-1643; the remainder completed by 1685
dates.altered: Wikipedia: 'A large addition was constructed in the early 18th century. A wooden floor was built over the original dirt floor around 1730.'
dates.note: As the Wikipedia infobox states it. The node's own exemplar says the date 'is traditional, not dendrochronologically established, and later dates have been argued'; nothing read here settles it.

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 76001153; NJRHP No. 1385 (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
refs.note: Read from the infobox as the search result printed it, not from the National Register's own database. Added to the Register in 1976 per the article.

refs.title: NJRHP No. 1385 (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
C. A. Nothnagle Log House - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'built sometime between 1638 and 1643 by Finnish settlers in the colony of New Sweden'; 'The fireplace was probably built of bricks brought to America as ship's ballast.' Location as the infobox prints it: Swedesboro-Paulsboro Road, Gibbstown.

note: No HABS survey was found ('Nothnagle log house Gibbstown Gloucester County New Jersey HABS NJ survey' on loc.gov returned unrelated New Jersey surveys). The scandinavian-log-vernacular node names it at 'Gibbstown, New Jersey, USA' -- a different location string, so a different join key, and that node is not listed here. Seeded 4 Sep 2026.
